description: Iteration 2 summary figure: cross-kingdom conservation heatmap, alignment robustness, and sel0 insertion map
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
OUT=os.getcwd()
S=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/table8_crosskingdom_selo_panel.csv")
R=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/table7_alignment_robustness.csv")
I=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/table10_sel0_insertions.csv")
pos=['D91','R93','K113','D125','E136','R176','R183','D252','N253','D262']
okc=[f"ok_{p}" for p in pos]
S["core5"]=S[["ok_K113","ok_E136","ok_D252","ok_N253","ok_D262"]].sum(axis=1)

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,8.6))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1.1,1],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.3)

# panel A: heatmap of conservation by group
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
grp=["Bacteria","Archaea","Fungi","Other eukaryotes","Viridiplantae","Metazoa"]
H=S.groupby("group")[okc].mean().mul(100).reindex(grp)
cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("c",["#B71C1C","#F9A825","#F1F8E9","#2E7D32"])
im=ax.imshow(H.values,cmap=cmap,vmin=0,vmax=100,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(10)); ax.set_xticklabels(pos,fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(grp)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{g} (n={int((S.group==g).sum())})" for g in grp],fontsize=9)
for i in range(len(grp)):
    for j in range(10):
        v=H.values[i,j]
        ax.text(j,i,f"{v:.0f}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8,
                color="white" if v<60 or v>97 else "black")
ax.set_title("Conservation (%) of the ten PsSelO active-site positions across 254 PF02696 proteins,\n"
             "one per genus. S. pombe sel0 scores 10/10. R93 is lost in 88% of Metazoa, including human SELENOO.",
             fontsize=10.5)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,fraction=0.025,pad=0.01,label="% conserved")

# panel B: alignment robustness
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
prots=["sel0_SCHPO","Fmp40_SACCE","YdiU_ECOLI","SELENOO_HUMAN"]
nun=R.groupby("protein")[pos].nunique().reindex(prots)
im2=ax.imshow(nun.values,cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("d",["#2E7D32","#B71C1C"]),vmin=1,vmax=3,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(10)); ax.set_xticklabels(pos,fontsize=8,rotation=45)
ax.set_yticks(range(4)); ax.set_yticklabels(prots,fontsize=8.5)
for i in range(4):
    for j in range(10): ax.text(j,i,int(nun.values[i,j]),ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8,color="white")
ax.set_title("Mapping stability: distinct residues assigned across\n10 gap-penalty settings (1 = fully stable)",fontsize=9.5)

# panel C: insertions relative to catalytic positions
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
cat=[91,93,113,125,136,176,183,252,253,262]
ax.hlines(0,0,487,color="#90A4AE",lw=6)
for c in cat: ax.vlines(c,-0.35,0.35,color="#C62828",lw=1.6)
for _,q in I.iterrows():
    ax.bar(q.after_PsSelO_pos,q.length/10,width=6,bottom=0.4,color="#1565C0")
    ax.text(q.after_PsSelO_pos,0.42+q.length/10,f"{int(q.length)}",ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlim(-15,500); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,4.2)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("PsSelO residue number (6EAC numbering)")
ax.set_title("sel0 insertions (blue, length in aa) relative to the PsSelO fold.\n"
             "Red ticks are the ten catalytic positions; nearest insertion is 29 aa away.",fontsize=9.5)
ax.annotate("N-terminal\nextension (30 aa)",(1,3.4),fontsize=7.5,ha='left')
plt.show()
print("panel data:\nH=\n",H.round(1).to_string(),"\n\nstability (distinct residues):\n",nun.to_string())
